items.text: Review Paystack, payout and fee configuration
Guest pays the Paystack collection fee, grossed up and stored on the booking
Lock add-ons once a booking is paid and record add-on money on the booking
Reserve Paystack's transfer fee in the payout balance check
Report add-on and gateway fee money in the revenue report
Add gateway fee tests; server suite, lint and build pass
Re-run the server tests and the frontend build to confirm the committed state
Stage the twelve files, the migration and the new test
Commit as one focused change and push to origin/main
Record the pushed change in the project plan
